description: Land Title Settlement Department - Seema, Nuwaragampalatha D/S Division, Anuradhapura District - Cad. Map No.110196 (24/0276)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of land title determinations for specific parcels of land, including detailed property descriptions, ownership details, and legal status of land titles. The content falls squarely within the Land Gazettes category as it involves land registrations, property ownership determinations, and land title settlements without any government personnel changes or structural administrative matters.
